description: Per-feature standardisation constants for the neural rendering network. Part of the ABI: the shader must apply the same affine before the first matmul. Regenerate with `python tools/train_neural/dataset_stats.py`.
why: Without standardisation the layer-1 pre-activation std is 0.0118, half the ReLU units die at init, and training converges to `out = anchor + constant` -- a single number worth +2.4 dB that is indistinguishable from a working model by any accuracy metric.
